annotations.title: Forecasts for Poland: European Commission, OECD, NBP, Finwire Nowcast

description: Use for forecasts of GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, deficit and public debt of Poland for this and next year from the European Commission, OECD and NBP, how forecasts changed and which institution was most accurate. Say which institution and edition each number comes from and that these are forecasts, not finwire.pl advice. For the next CPI reading or RPP decision, use get_nowcast. Latest edition of every institution with forecasts of real GDP growth, annual average inflation (European Commission: HICP; NBP, OECD and Finwire Nowcast: CPI), unemployment (LFS), general government balance and debt as % of GDP for the current and next years, the previous edition, outturns, mean forecast errors of each institution (forecasts made a year earlier) and the finwire index finwire_forecast_accuracy. Every edition is stored separately (European Commission since spring 2011). Finwire Konsensus is included only for indicators where it beat the best single institution in the backtest. Optional year selects the target year in the summary.

year.description: Target year in the summary; default the year after the latest European Commission edition.
